title: Machine-learning based strategy identifies a robust protein biomarker panel for Alzheimer’s disease in cerebrospinal fluid
summary: The preprint evaluates the panel across five Alzheimer’s and neurodegeneration cohorts, including mild-cognitive-impairment discrimination. This supports a candidate biomarker and diagnostic result, not clinical utility or a validated treatment decision.
